summary: Phase 2 V1 comprehensive testing completed. Backend: 35/37 tests passed (94.6%). Frontend: All major features tested and working. CityBrain AI chat, trip planner, explore map, weather, emergency, Nepal intelligence, budget, saved items, and profile all functional. Theme toggle working. No critical bugs found.

flaky_endpoints.impact: Frontend needs to handle long wait times with proper loading states
flaky_endpoints.note: This is expected behavior for AI generation, not a bug. Frontend should show loading indicator for 30-40s.

Backend: Cities list (11 cities found)
